arxiv-2102-10048.title: Approximate Bayes factors for unit root testing
arxiv-2102-10048.creator: Martin Magris, Alexandros Iosifidis
arxiv-2102-10048.description: Abstract This paper introduces a feasible and practical Bayesian method for unit root testing in financial time series. We propose a convenient approximation of the Bayes factor in terms of the Bayesian Information Criterion as a straightforward and effective strategy for testing the unit root hypothesis.

arxiv-2105-07304.title: Fast-forwarding quantum evolution
arxiv-2105-07304.creator: Shouzhen Gu, Rolando D. Somma, Burak Şahinoğlu
arxiv-2105-07304.description: Abstract We investigate the problem of fast-forwarding quantum evolution, whereby the dynamics of certain quantum systems can be simulated with gate complexity that is sublinear in the evolution time. We provide a definition of fast-forwarding that considers the model of quantum computation, the Hamiltonians that induce the evolution, and the properties of the initial states.

arxiv-2302-08263.title: Meta-Auto-Decoder: A Meta-Learning Based Reduced Order Model for Solving Parametric Partial Differential Equations
arxiv-2302-08263.creator: Zhanhong Ye, Xiang Huang, Hongsheng Liu, Bin Dong
arxiv-2302-08263.description: Abstract Many important problems in science and engineering require solving the so-called parametric partial differential equations (PDEs), i.e., PDEs with different physical parameters, boundary conditions, shapes of computational domains, etc. Typical reduced order modeling techniques accelarate solution of the parametric PDEs by projecting them onto a linear trial manifold constructed in the offline stage.

arxiv-2310-03623.title: Robustness and complexity of directed and weighted metabolic hypergraphs
arxiv-2310-03623.creator: Pietro Traversa, Guilherme Ferraz de Arruda, Alexei Vazquez, Yamir Moreno
arxiv-2310-03623.description: Abstract Metabolic networks are probably among the most challenging and important biological networks. Their study provides insight into how biological pathways work and how robust a specific organism is against an environment or therapy. Here we propose a directed hypergraph with edge-dependent vertex weight as a novel framework to represent metabolic networks.

arxiv-2311-09992.title: q q -Racah probability distribution
arxiv-2311-09992.creator: Masahito Hayashi 1,2,3, AKIHITO HORA 4, SHINTAROU YANAGIDA 3
arxiv-2311-09992.description: Abstract . We introduce a certain discrete probability distribution P n , m , k , l ; q P_{n,m,k,l;q} having non-negative integer parameters n , m , k , l n,m,k,l and quantum parameter q q which arises from a zonal spherical function of the Grassmannian over the finite field 𝔽 q \mathbb{F}_{q} with a distinguished spherical vector.

arxiv-2402-00048.title: IICONGRAPH: improved Iconographic and Iconological Statements in Knowledge Graphs
arxiv-2402-00048.creator: Bruno Sartini
arxiv-2402-00048.description: Abstract Iconography and iconology are fundamental domains when it comes to understanding artifacts of cultural heritage. Iconography deals with the study and interpretation of visual elements depicted in artifacts and their symbolism, while iconology delves deeper, exploring the underlying cultural and historical meanings.

arxiv-2511-10813.title: Four plane unit vectors generate a 3 3 -colorable graph
arxiv-2511-10813.creator: Katherine Eng, Timothy Harris, Mike Krebs, Mason Meeks, Claudia Maria Schmidt
arxiv-2511-10813.description: Abstract . We show that given an arbitrary set of four plane unit vectors v 1 , v 2 , v 3 , v 4 v_{1},v_{2},v_{3},v_{4} , the Cayley graph generated by { ± v 1 , ± v 2 , ± v 3 , ± v 4 } \{\pm v_{1},\pm v_{2},\pm v_{3},\pm v_{4}\} is always 3 3 -colorable.

arxiv-2512-19585.title: Increasing the Thinking Budget is Not All You Need
arxiv-2512-19585.creator: Ignacio Iacobacci, Zhaozhi Qian, Faroq AL-Tam
arxiv-2512-19585.description: Abstract Recently, a new wave of thinking-capable Large Language Models has emerged, demonstrating exceptional capabilities across a wide range of reasoning benchmarks. Early studies have begun to explore how the amount of compute in terms of the length of the reasoning process, the so-called thinking budget , impacts model performance.

arxiv-2601-17621.title: Non-parametric finite-sample credible intervals with one-dimensional priors: a middle ground between Bayesian and frequentist intervals
arxiv-2601-17621.creator: Tim Ritmeester, PhD
arxiv-2601-17621.description: Abstract We propose a new type of statistical interval obtained by weakening the definition of a p % p\% credible interval: Having observed the interval (rather than the full dataset) we should put at least a p % p\% belief in it.

pmc-10735920.title: HARNESSING COMPLEMENTARY RESEARCH SKILLS TO ADVANCE RESEARCH ON FINANCIAL DECISION MAKING
pmc-10735920.creator: Marti DeLiema, Laura Hemmy
pmc-10735920.description: Financial decision making comprises a set of cognitive skills including problem-solving, critical thinking, and an understanding of key financial facts that help people make informed decisions about their money. Research indicates that financial decision making is one of the earliest areas of cognitive functioning to be affected by aging and by aging-related neurological disease.

pmc-11335125.title: Rectus femoris electromyography signal clustering: Data-driven management of crouch gait in patients with cerebral palsy
pmc-11335125.creator: Mehrdad Davoudi, Firooz Salami, Robert Reisig, Dimitrios A. Patikas, Sebastian I. Wolf, Jyotindra Narayan, Jyotindra Narayan, Jyotindra Narayan, Jyotindra Narayan
pmc-11335125.description: This study aimed to investigate how electromyography (EMG) cluster analysis of the rectus femoris (RF) could help to better interpret gait analysis in patients with cerebral palsy (CP). The retrospective gait data of CP patients were categorized into two groups: initial examination (E1, 881 patients) and subsequent examination (E2, 377 patients). Envelope-formatted EMG data of RF were collected.

pmc-11600944.title: Associations Between Physical Activity and Preserved Ratio Impaired Spirometry: A Cross-Sectional NHANES Study
pmc-11600944.creator: Xiaofang Fu, JiangYing Guo, Xiaofei Gu, Liyan Chen, Jiangang Ju, Huaqiong Huang
pmc-11600944.description: BackgroundPreserved ratio impaired spirometry (PRISm) is considered to be one of the early chronic obstructive pulmonary disease states, and there are few studies on PRISm prevention. We aimed to evaluate the relationship between physical activity and the risk of PRISm.

pmc-12387509.title: Contralateral Robotic-Assisted Anatomical Resection for Synchronous or Metachronous Lung Cancer: A Retrospective Case Series
pmc-12387509.creator: Alessio Campisi, Nabil Khan, Federica Pinna, Dennis Aliev, Raffaella Griffo, Philip Baum, Werner Schmidt, Hauke Winter, Martin Eichhorn
pmc-12387509.description: Background: Advances in screening programs have led to increased detection of early-stage non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), including synchronous or metachronous nodules amenable to surgical resection. Patients requiring contralateral anatomical lung resections present a unique surgical challenge due to potential impairments in lung function and the complexities of one-lung ventilation.

pmc-12630751.title: Data-driven universal insights into tumorigenesis via hallmark networks
pmc-12630751.creator: Jiahe Wang, Yan Wu, Yuke Hou, Yang Li, Dachuan Xu, Changjing Zhuge, Yue Han
pmc-12630751.description: Cancers are complex diseases characterized by dynamic perturbations of regulatory networks across multiple hierarchical levels, which cannot be fully captured by alterations in a small number of genes. To this end, based on the concept of Hallmarks of Cancer, a whole genomic data-driven approach is proposed to capture the dynamic variation from normal to cancerous cells.

pmc-12714084.title: Nurses’ Perceptions of Authentic Leadership and Quality of Nursing Care: The Mediating Role of Psychological Empowerment
pmc-12714084.creator: Chiu-Shu Fang, Cheng-Hsien Li, Su-Chiu Hsiao, Chun-Chang Lin, Fang-Ming Hwang, Fan-Hao Chou, Shu-Ching Ma, Jacopo Fiorini
pmc-12714084.description: BackgroundPsychological empowerment plays a crucial role in influencing both the quality of nursing care and nurses’ self‐perceptions. However, limited research has examined its mediating effect on the relationship between nurses’ perceptions of authentic leadership and the quality of care provided.

pmc-13089518.title: Intraepidermal nerve fiber density as a predictor of cardiac events in Fabry disease
pmc-13089518.creator: Kolja Lau, Dan Liu, Victoria Sokalski, Maximilian Gram, Kai Hu, Aljosha Lang, Christoph Wanner, Claudia Sommer, Nurcan Üçeyler, Peter Nordbeck
pmc-13089518.description: AimsAnderson-Fabry disease (FD) is a rare lysosomal storage disorder with multi-organ involvement. Cardiac manifestations are the major determinant of prognosis, yet reliable predictors of disease progression are lacking. Small fiber neuropathy can emerge in various aetiologies of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, but its correlation remains unclear.

pmc-13299395.title: Establishing Reference Intervals for White Blood Cell and Absolute Neutrophil Counts in Duffy Null Individuals
pmc-13299395.creator: Mohammad Barouqa, Muhammad Areeb Ashfaq, Katrina J. Jiang, Huseyin Kilic, Nestor Dela Cruz, Aariez Khalid, Marianne E. Yassa
pmc-13299395.description: Background/Objectives: The Duffy (Fy) blood group system, encoded by the ACKR1 gene, plays a key role in transfusion medicine and host susceptibility to malarial infections such as Plasmodium vivax. The Duffy-null phenotype [Fy(a−b−)] is associated with lower baseline white blood cell (WBC) and absolute neutrophil count (ANC) values despite a benign clinical course.

pmc-13378506.title: The MEC90 of Ropivacaine for Ultrasound-Guided Pectoral Nerve Block Type II for Modified Radical Mastectomy: A Biased-Coin Up-and-Down Sequential Trial
pmc-13378506.creator: Yu Du, Wenbo Liu, Yangyang Wu, Lin Ma, Yi Tang, Ji Wang
